newsitem.title: USA: Vasco sees Q4 loss of $7.8 mln-$9.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Vasco sees Q4 loss of $7.8 mln-$9.3 mln.

text.p: Vasco Corp said Monday it expects to report a net loss for the fourth quarter of between $7,820,000 and $9,320,000.
Vasco said the expected fourth quarter loss reflects charges of $7.0 million to $8.5 million for acquired in-process technology.
The company said it expects a net loss for the year of between $8,220,000 and $9,720,000.

Vasco said revenues for the fourth quarter rose to $3,300,000, up from $1,500,000 a year ago. Excluding the writeoff of acquired in-process technology, it projected a net loss after taxes of $820,000, compared with a loss $453,000 in the 1995 period.
For the year, its net operating loss after taxes increased to $1,220,000 from a loss in 1995 of $357,000, excluding the writeoff.
Revenues for the year were about $9,500,000, up more than 150 percent from $3,800,000 a year ago.

"The one-tiome writeoff was in line with internal company projections based on independent third party valuations and industry standards and practices," T. Kendall Hunt, president, said in a statement. "In addition to the writeoff, the reported loss includes a number of one-time legal and accounting costs associated with acquisitions."
The in-process technology writeoff was related to Vasco's acquisitions of Lintel and Digipass last summer.

"As the writeoff related to acquired in-process technology, there is no practical affect upon the company's capital position, as it represents a non-cash charge against net income," Greg Apple, vice president of finance, added.
